summary: The diff implements both REQ-1 and REQ-2 with substantial coverage. REQ-1 is addressed via the new BeneficiaryChecklistSelector component and DistribusiPage updates. REQ-2 is addressed via backend batch distribution logic and the useCatatDistribusiBatched hook. However, there are some notable gaps: the grouping uses 'alamat' (address) field rather than a dedicated 'desa' field, and backward compatibility of single-beneficiary creation needs verification from truncated backend code.

missing_requirements.requirement: Village grouping must use the existing 'desa' field already present in Sasaran records.
missing_requirements.reason: The BeneficiaryChecklistSelector groups by 'alamat' (address) field, not a dedicated 'desa' field. The constraint explicitly states village grouping must use the existing desa field. The SasaranRecord type shown in both backend/main.mo and backend/migration.mo has no separate 'desa' field, only 'alamat', suggesting the grouping implementation may not align with the intended field.

hallucinated_features.description: A Desa column was added to the distribution list table in DistribusiPage.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not mention adding a Desa column to the distribution table. REQ-2 only requires that batch-created entries are correctly displayed, not that a new column be added.

hallucinated_features.description: Per-village select-all checkbox functionality in BeneficiaryChecklistSelector.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not mention a select-all per village group feature. Requirements only specify expanding/collapsing groups and checking/unchecking individual beneficiaries.

hallucinated_features.description: Success/failure result alerts using BatchedDistribusiResult shown after batch submission.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not specify showing per-item success/failure result alerts after batch submission. This goes beyond what was specified in REQ-1 or REQ-2.
